description.value: JV Bike is a full-service bicycle shop on Expo Boulevard in Vancouver, selling and servicing a broad range of bikes including electric, folding, cargo, and gravel models from brands such as Norco, Bianchi, and Dahon. The in-house repair workshop offers free safety inspections and estimates, with most tune-ups and repairs completed same-day. Bike and e-bike rentals are also available, making it a practical one-stop for touring cyclists needing service, parts, or a loaner in central Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces, covered) at 4m; stands (2 spaces) at 12m; stands (6 spaces) at 25m; stands (2 spaces) at 26m; stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (2 spaces) at 77m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and provides strong primary evidence. The bicycle-service page explicitly states 'most of our repairs and tune-ups are done the same day' and offers free safety checks with every repair, confirming mechanical staff support. The rentals page lists multiple rental categories including e-bikes and trikes; the dedicated 'Electric Systems and Parts' product tree and extensive e-bike FAQ confirm e-bike sales and servicing capability. A 'SPECIAL ANNOUNCEMENT - May 18 to May 25, 2026' on the front page confirms the business is actively operating.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists two numbers (604-694-2453 and 604-630-3798). Primary number 604-694-2453 used in the phone field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service bike shop with confirmed same-day repairs, e-bike service, and multi-category rentals in central Vancouver — a clear and useful listing for touring cyclists.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: Service page: 'most of our repairs and tune-ups are done the same day.'

E-bike service.detail: Dedicated 'Electric Systems and Parts' product category covering motors/drive units, batteries, controllers, cables, and chargers; extensive e-bike FAQ; e-bikes sold and serviced in-shop

Bike rentals.detail: Rentals page lists adult and kid's bicycles, child seats/trailers, adult trikes (standard and electric), and electric bicycles (Norco Indie VLT); helmets and locks included at no extra charge
